# fjordrun_team_members (Data Source)

A team's members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_team_members" "all" {
  team_id = var.team_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
